turns.question: Which customer country cancelled the biggest share of its orders between 17 August and 30 September 2026, and what share?
turns.answer: The United States (US) cancelled the biggest share of its orders, 13.3%, over 17 August to 30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which country cancelled the smallest share?
turns.answer: The United Kingdom (GB) cancelled the smallest share, 6.1%, over the same period, 17 August to 30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
